title: 安田記念の後に・確かな異変

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokyo Racecourse rumbles with the sound of thunderous applause after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text: Ready? Aaand… Good job, Fujiii!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Look, I got a really good video of her running! I've gotta post it ASAP!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Her next race is going to be the autumn Tenno Sho, right? I'll have to take the day off to watch it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The whole world believes in Fuji Kiseki's skills and expects great things from her in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The air buzzes with excitement, but I'm troubled by something I noticed during the race.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I didn't watch her run literally every day, I might have missed it, but something was off about her running.
choice_data_list: (Something's wrong with her. I just know it.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurry to the runners' tunnel to catch up with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She left already. Mentioned wantin' to fine-tune somethin' or other.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She told me to make up some excuse for her so you wouldn't worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She and I aren't exactly strangers, bein' fellow dorm leaders and all, so…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'd like to think I know her fairly well. Is somethin' up with her?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Knew it… Don't think she'll spill the beans to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Guess you're the only one who can get anythin' from her. It's up to you now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush back to the school, hoping I can catch up to Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race will be the medium-distance autumn Tenno Sho. But, before that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to find out what's wrong with Fuji Kiseki!
